None is a forbidden_class. Own repro (scratch gate, real scope.yaml): a/google-services.json, a/credentials.json, a/service-account-x.json, a/.venv/x.py, a/.pytest_cache/x, a/logs/x.log each give P3=PASS (false-null), control a/localhost.key P3=FAIL. 11.4.275(B) one class source; 11.4.273(f) set coverage.

findings.title: --live-proofs accepts self-asserted evidence hashes not bound to any file; INCOMPLETE turns into PASS with no evidence
findings.detail: Own repro: live.json with P4/P5/P6 verdict PASS, cmd 'echo trust me', evidence_sha256 = 64 zeros, plus --lumen-status (Captured 2000-01-01), --lumen-files, a matching lumenignore pair and a hand-written all-rc-0 drift report -> verdict PASS, complete=true, rc=0. The gate never reads an evidence file, so the hash proves nothing (11.4.115(F) machine-written verdicts, 11.4.262). The T025 per-unit fallback (grep plus reads) is entered the same way and is recorded identically to a live-index PASS (no evidence-class field, 11.4.226). Same for --drift-report (hand-written JSON accepted, no HEAD/repo binding).
findings.required_fix: Require an evidence path per live proof, hash the file in the gate and compare; add a closed kind field {live, fallback} recorded in the output (fallback never reported as a live PASS); bind the drift report to the HEAD/scope sha it judged.

findings.title: Rendered .lumenignore depends on untracked host-local directories, so the drift gate is host-dependent
findings.detail: gen_lumenignore.py enumerates top-level entries with os.listdir. Rendering the working-tree lumen_scope.json against a skeleton of git ls-files --recurse-submodules drops 6 lines the committed .lumenignore holds: /.claude/, /.git/, /.remember/, /catalogizer-test-zzsw10647std/, /prev3/, /reports/ (the last three are untracked, empty or local dirs; catalogizer-test-* looks like a test temp dir). A fresh clone (no .claude/.remember/prev3/...) therefore gets lumenignore_fresh rc=1 -> P-ScopeDrift FAIL (11.4.201(1) false refusal), and any stray test dir on the host flips it (11.4.50). The committed artifact also embeds a host-local temp dir name.
findings.required_fix: Render from the tracked tree (git ls-files / ls-tree, plus a fixed list of known host-local dirs), or exclude untracked entries in scope_drift_check; re-render and add a clean-skeleton determinism test.

findings.title: Case behaviour of the class regexes is not pinned against the indexers' matchers
findings.detail: secret_basename is (?i) while the scope exclude *secret* is a gitignore pattern; under git check-ignore semantics docs/security/SECRETS_MANAGEMENT.md (tracked) is NOT excluded yet the gate FAILs it, and a/server.PEM, a/Release.JKS, a/.ENV are excluded by neither (P3 PASS). The runner's matcher is the node 'ignore' lib for codegraph.json patterns but .gitignore rules pass through git; which case rule wins on the real index is UNCONFIRMED. 11.4.276(B) ground-truth probe.
findings.required_fix: Probe the runner and Lumen matchers on mixed-case fixtures and make the class regexes match the measured behaviour; add case fixtures.
